acc:record.export/c-bd1acd26102d2d92.claim: An export carries the lineage and every entry once.
acc:record.export/c-bd1acd26102d2d92.observes: cli: `record export --world town3 --out run.jsonl --json` prints the line count and lineage naming town1; the file's first line is the lineage and the entries follow in order.

acc:world.clock.warp/c-2bceeaa41942995d.claim: A warp moves the chain and every site together and runs what fell due.
acc:world.clock.warp/c-2bceeaa41942995d.observes: cli: in `world-frozen`, `world clock warp town1 --by 7d` prints worldNow a week on; a company's site shows its scheduled job ran for each day; `--by -1d` exits INVALID_INPUT.

acc:world.create/c-52e22ec1e2a6c1cc.claim: A new world runs with its clock and a record that begins with its birth.
acc:world.create/c-52e22ec1e2a6c1cc.observes: cli: from `empty-devnet`, `world create town1 --template empty --clock frozen --json` prints creating; `world show town1` then prints running, clockMode frozen, epoch 1 and recordHead 1; `record list --world town1` lists one `born` entry.

acc:world.show/c-6aa449b0c9f7abaf.claim: A world restored into another names its parent.
acc:world.show/c-6aa449b0c9f7abaf.observes: cli: in `world-with-snapshot`, after `world snapshot restore town1 m3 --as town3`, `world show town3 --json` prints parentWorld town1, parentSnapshot m3 and parentSeq.

acc:world.snapshot.restore/c-1dd79fdbcb1.claim: A restore into a separate world leaves the first world untouched and the two never see each other.
acc:world.snapshot.restore/c-1dd79fdbcb1.observes: cli: `world snapshot restore town1 m3 --as town3`; both worlds list their companies on their own addresses; a command in town3 changes nothing in town1; the new born entry names town1, m3 and the sequence.

acc:world.snapshot.restore/c-369b1db183b.claim: An in-place restore returns the world to the snapshot and records it.
acc:world.snapshot.restore/c-369b1db183b.observes: cli: in `world-with-snapshot`, after more commands, `world snapshot restore town1 m3`; the diff against the saved world is empty, epoch is one higher, the record has a `restore` entry and the earlier branch is listed as abandoned.

acc:world.snapshot.save/c-69e4dbcdf13e37.claim: A snapshot saves everything that makes the world and leaves it untouched.
acc:world.snapshot.save/c-69e4dbcdf13e37.observes: cli: `world snapshot save town1 m3 --json` prints the epoch and recordSeq; the world's record gains no entry but the save; `world snapshot list town1` lists it.
